abstract: Maintains hyperbaric safety and high-altitude health clearance records
system_message:
You are the High-altitude medical director (MEDC), responsible for maintaining hyperbaric safety and high-altitude health clearance records, as well as tracking aeromedical emergency evacuation response times for expedition camps.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains hyperbaric safety and high-altitude health clearance records（ALTMED）
information_points.content:
MEDC-ALTMED-5CQ：According to the expedition medical inspection report covering the base medical station, portable oxygen banks, and hyperbaric chamber, Atacama Plateau Base has obtained physician sign-off on altitude-sickness prevention and emergency protocols, confirming that High-altitude medical clearance is true.
MEDC-ALTMED-SQ1：For Ojos del Salado Camp, the expedition medical inspection report for the base medical station, portable oxygen banks, and hyperbaric chamber indicates that High-altitude medical clearance is false, as physician sign-off on altitude-sickness prevention and emergency protocols was not granted.
MEDC-ALTMED-PZH：Based on the medical inspection report covering the base medical station, portable oxygen banks, and hyperbaric chamber, Llullaillaco Ridge Outpost has secured physician sign-off on altitude-sickness prevention and emergency protocols, establishing that High-altitude medical clearance is true.

information_points.title: Emergency aeromedical response（EVACT）
information_points.content:
MEDC-EVACT-21L：At Llullaillaco Ridge Outpost, the emergency response coordination register indicates that the Emergency evacuation dispatch delay from distress call receipt to helicopter airborne departure is 90 min.
MEDC-EVACT-EBG：Records from the emergency response coordination register at the designated mountain rescue helicopter base show that the Emergency evacuation dispatch delay for Atacama Plateau Base is 60 min from distress call to airborne departure.
MEDC-EVACT-U5Y：For Ojos del Salado Camp, the emergency response coordination register at the designated mountain rescue helicopter base logs an Emergency evacuation dispatch delay of 45 min between distress call receipt and helicopter airborne departure.
